camera: 50mm natural-perspective framing with the full focal subject visible; retain any lens explicitly chosen for the shot. Suggested framing: medium close-up, eye level.
cameraMove: Static camera on a locked tripod. The full focal subject stays inside the fixed frame.
depth: brass tray foreground, subject midground, cedar door background
population: At most one chosen fictional adult; no background crowds; no readable signage (add any text in editing); matte surfaces, no mirrors facing the camera.
